data.body: **[P2] Re-throw fatal failures while preparing an initialization error.** If MDC capture fails ordinarily and error-response serialization subsequently throws `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath`, this capture settles the caller but returns normally from the actual executor worker. That relocates the fatal and leaves the affected worker alive, unlike the fatal-preservation logic used for capture and normal preparation failures. Capture the outcome, complete `result`, then call `rethrowLifecycleFatal` on its failure before returning; add asynchronous and inline regression tests.
